scripts.check: node scripts/build-worklets.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p worklets/tsconfig.json && tsc -p mock/tsconfig.json
scripts.e2e: node scripts/build-worklets.mjs && next build && playwright test --project static --project dev
scripts.screenshots: node scripts/build-worklets.mjs && next build && playwright test --project screenshots
scripts.e2e:real: export PVA_WEB_EXPORT_DIR="${PVA_WEB_EXPORT_DIR:-out-e2e}" && node scripts/build-worklets.mjs && next build && playwright test -c playwright.real.config.ts --project real
scripts.bench:browser: node scripts/build-worklets.mjs && next build && playwright test -c playwright.real.config.ts --project real-latency
scripts.screenshots:real: node scripts/build-worklets.mjs && next build && playwright test -c playwright.real.config.ts --project real-screenshots
